    StartersKing Argotron's roast battle drumsticksGarlic rosemary drumsticks glazed with honey and wholegrain mustardHow to make it12 chicken drumsticksvegetable oil, to taste3 garlic cloves1 bunch rosemarysmoked paprika, to taste3 tbsp honey2 tbsp wholegrain mustardHeat the oven to 200°C.Rub the chicken drumsticks with the oil, the crushed garlic cloves, the chopped rosemary, the smoked paprika and salt.Roast on a lined tray for 35 minutes.Mix the honey and the wholegrain mustard, brush over and roast 10 minutes more until sticky.Wrap the bones in baking paper and serve on a board.Sturdy Wings honey soy chicken wingsCrisp baked wings in a sticky honey soy glazeHow to make it1.2kg chicken wings2 tsp baking powder4 tbsp honeysoy sauce, to taste2 garlic cloves1 knob ginger1 tbsp rice vinegarsesame seeds, to taste2 spring onions1 tsp saltHeat the oven to 220°C.Toss the chicken wings with the baking powder and the salt and bake on a rack for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp.Simmer the honey, the soy, the crushed garlic cloves, the grated ginger and the rice vinegar for 3 minutes until syrupy.Toss the wings in the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.MainsRonnie's double cheeseburgers and friesTwo smashed beef patties, cheese and pickle sauce, with paprika friesHow to make it750g frozen friespaprika, to taste800g beef mince8 cheese slices4 tbsp mayonnaisetomato sauce, to tastemustard, to taste1 jar dill pickles1 white onion4 burger bunsBake the frozen fries at 220°C for 25 minutes and toss with salt and paprika.Roll the beef mince into balls.Smash flat on a very hot plate, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute.Mix the mayonnaise, the tomato sauce, the mustard and chopped pickles.Toast the buns, Meanwhile bake the cornbread to the packet directions.Serve with sour cream, cheddar and warm cornbread.SweetsKingdom of LAIRE honey spice cakesWarm spiced honey cakes with orange honey glaze and thick creamHow to make it125g butter230g honey2 eggs200g self-raising flourmixed spice, to taste80ml milk1 orange200ml thick cream30g flaked almondsHeat the oven to 175°C.Melt the butter with the honey, cool slightly, then whisk in the eggs.Fold in the self-raising flour, the mixed spice and the milk.Divide between the greased muffin holes and bake 18 to 20 minutes.Warm the honey with the juice of the orange and spoon over the hot cakes.Serve with thick cream and toasted flaked almonds.DrinksMinotaur ginger and lime fizzSpicy ginger syrup, lime and soda water over iceHow to make it100g ginger120g sugarchilli flakes, to taste4 limes800ml soda water1 bunch mint3 cups crushed iceSimmer the sliced ginger, the sugar, the water and a pinch of chilli flakes for 10 minutes.Cool and strain.Fill the tall glasses with crushed ice.Add the ginger syrup and the lime juice to each and top with the cold soda water.Stir and garnish with a lime wheel and mint.
